What is a good IDE/Text editor for working with CSS?

What I do when I'm developing the CSS is type in a code editor (I use Atom) and save it in my Dropbox folder. Then I use @import in my subverse's CSS to load my stylesheet from Dropbox. I simply save my document and refresh the page to see the result. I also use the web inspector tool in Firefox to test little things.

This method is especially useful to me because I write in SCSS and my code needs to run through the pre-processor first.
